import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng = random.Random(3)
n = 96
edges = []
node = 0; diamonds = 0; li=[0]
def lab():
    li[0]+=1
    return rng.choice(["a","b","c","d","e","0a","f2"])[:8]
while node+3 <= 38 and diamonds < 12:
    a,b,c,d = node,node+1,node+2,node+3
    for (x,y) in ((a,b),(a,c),(b,d),(c,d)):
        edges.append({"u":x,"v":y,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,10000),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,10000),"label":lab()})
    node=d; diamonds+=1
chain_tail = node
while node+1 < n-1:
    edges.append({"u":node,"v":node+1,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,300),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,300),"label":lab()})
    node+=1
# dead-end attractor: node n-1 is destination; make node n-2 able to reach dest
edges.append({"u":node,"v":n-1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
# extra edges into late chain nodes (each adds 1 path)
for k in range(chain_tail, n-1):
    if len(edges) >= 350: break
    if not any(e["u"]==0 and e["v"]==k for e in edges):
        edges.append({"u":0,"v":k,"ping_us":rng.randint(1,50),"ack_us":rng.randint(1,50),"label":lab()})
# extra edges from 1..5 into dead-end-ish nodes (still reach dest through chain -> too many paths?)
# instead: extra edges between late chain nodes and mid nodes that end at dead ends?  All nodes
# reach the destination here, so just add edges from node 1 into late nodes (paths from 1 -> dest
# are counted only if reachable from source; node 1 is reachable only if there is an edge into it,
# which there isn't if diamond skipped it... ensure no edges into node 1..3 from source:
guard = not any((e["u"]==0 and e["v"]==1) for e in edges)
docs_r = []
rounds=[{"launch_us":rng.choice([0,0,1,5,50,1000]),"timeout_us":rng.choice([10,100,1000,1000000]),
         "host_delay_us":rng.choice([1,5,10000]),"drop_host_ack":rng.random()<0.15,
         "drop_ping":rng.sample(range(len(edges)), rng.randint(0,min(5,len(edges)))),
         "drop_ack":rng.sample(range(len(edges)), rng.randint(0,min(5,len(edges))))} for _ in range(48)]
doc = {"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[rng.choice([0,1,2,48]) for _ in range(n)],"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}
print("edges:", len(edges), "guard(no 0->1):", guard)
json.dump(doc, open('dense3.json','w'))
t0=time.time()
with open('dense3.json','rb') as f:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
print("rc", p.returncode, "%.2fs"%(t1-t0), "bytes", len(p.stdout))
if p.returncode == 0:
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print("paths:", out["summary"]["topology_paths"], "classes:", len(out["classes"]),
          "alloc:", out["metrics"]["allocations"], "dedup:", out["metrics"]["deduplicated_ping"],
          "capdrop:", out["metrics"]["capacity_drops"], "peak:", out["metrics"]["peak_entries"],
          "observed:", out["summary"]["observed_classes"], out["summary"]["coverage_status"])
